Grant (Auditor): Hi team — for the SOC 2 audit we need evidence for a few items:
1) Retention policy and proof-of-retention for API auth/access logs and KMS/HSM operational logs
2) A sample export covering Mar 1-7 2025 with failed-auth events and related keystore ops, time-normalized to UTC
3) Repro steps (minimal playback) that show how you'd reproduce an auth failure for incident playback, plus chain-of-custody for the export.
Please include S3 presigned links, the exact aws cli commands you used to pull the data, and a list of staff who handled the export. Thanks.

maria-privsec: Hi Grant — we can produce this. Confirming mapping to CC6.2/CC7.1 controls for log retention and CC8 for key access. Do you want full request payloads or redacted samples?

Grant (Auditor): Redacted payloads are fine (hash PII). Need request headers and timestamps intact. No private keys or key material.

sam-support: Quick note on export job: we run a daily rollup into s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/YYYY-MM-DD/. Each export contains ndjson lines like: 
```
{"api_request_id":"...","user_id_hash":"...","timestamp_iso":"2025-03-03T12:01:23Z","error_code":"AUTH_FAIL","path":"/v1/generate","region":"us-west-2","auth_provider":"okta","keystore_op":"decrypt"}
```
Example aws cli to fetch a batch (use auditor profile):
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/2025-03-01-07/failures.ndjson.gz ./ --profile auditor-download
```
We also include a manifest file in the same prefix: failures.ndjson.gz.manifest.json (sha256 + exported_by + timestamp).

jake-sre: For playback we have a sanitized staging runbook. Example replay command (requires staging replay creds):
```bash
./replay.sh --start 2025-03-03T12:00:00Z --end 2025-03-03T12:10:00Z --filter "error=AUTH_FAIL" --env staging --output replay_capture.json
```
This replays the inbound request trace (sanitized) against a read-only staging stack and captures auth token exchange logs and keystore ops. Notes: 1) we never surface private key material in the replay, 2) replay requires a replay-manifest that maps api_request_id -> capture files, 3) requestor must sign an NDA for playback if it contains sensitive user metadata.

maria-privsec: Chain-of-custody for the export is recorded in the manifest object: exported_by, export_job_id, export_start_ts, export_end_ts, s3_prefix, sha256_sum, kms_key_arn_used_to_encrypt. We sign the manifest with the org signing key and encrypt the bundle using the customer-provided KMS key when requested. Retention policy: auth/access logs retained 3 years (UTC), keystore/HSM operational logs retained 7 years per policy.

Grant (Auditor): Good. Can you provide an example manifest snippet and the presigned link + hash for the sample window? Also need the list of personnel who accessed the export.

sam-support: Sample manifest snippet: 
```json
{"export_job_id":"exp-20250307-42","export_start_ts":"2025-03-01T00:00:00Z","export_end_ts":"2025-03-07T23:59:59Z","s3_prefix":"s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/2025-03-01-07/","sha256":"b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184","exported_by":"sam-support","kms_key_arn":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345"}
```
We'll generate the presigned URL and include the sha256 and manifest. ETA for the full package: EOD Thursday 2025-03-13.

Grant (Auditor): Please encrypt the package (server-side KMS ok) and provide the SHA256 and a signed manifest. Also provide a short repro checklist that an engineer can run in staging w/ provided creds.

maria-privsec: Understood. We'll include: 1) presigned s3 URL (7d expiry), 2) signed manifest, 3) replay runbook (playback steps + required roles), 4) list of handlers: maria-privsec, sam-support, jake-sre. Will also include mapping to SOC2 controls in a cover sheet.

evidence-bot: export job exp-20250307-42 completed by sam-support; uploaded manifest to s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/2025-03-01-07/failures.ndjson.gz.manifest.json

Grant (Auditor): Thanks — I'll validate the manifest and the sha256 once I get the link. If we need any additional snapshots (e.g., IAM policy at export time), I'll follow up.

maria-privsec: We'll attach the IAM policy snapshot and export ACLs in the same package. Ping me if you need immediate access and we'll extend the presigned link window.

Grant (Auditor): Appreciate it. I'll acknowledge when verification is done.
